incoming.name: Tour de France
incoming.excerpt: It is possible to win the overall race without winning any individual stages (which Greg LeMond did in 1990).

outgoing.name: Auto racing
outgoing.excerpt: He pursued auto racing briefly as a way to continue channeling his competitive drive.

outgoing.name: Paris
outgoing.excerpt: Heading into the final stage, however, an individual time trial finishing in Paris, LeMond was in second place overall.

outgoing.name: Tour de France
outgoing.excerpt: In 1986, he became the first American cyclist to win the Tour de France.

outgoing.name: United States
outgoing.excerpt: Gregory James "Greg" LeMond (born June 26, 1961 in Reno, Nevada) is a former professional road bicycle racer from the United States.
